record.original_question: Classify the dynamics around a fixed point of a holomorphic map on P^k or even just defined in a neighborhood of p. -sibony@anh.matups.fr

evidence.quote: Problem 10.3.5 Classify the dynamics around a fixed point of a holomorphic map on Pk or even just defined in a neighborhood of p. -sibony@anh.matups.fr

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $p \in \mathbb{P}^k(\mathbb{C})$ and let $f$ be a holomorphic map defined either on all of the complex projective space $\mathbb{P}^k$ or merely on an open neighborhood of $p$, with $f(p) = p$. Provide a classification of the possible local dynamical behaviors of the iterates $\{f^n\}_{n \geq 0}$ in a neighborhood of the fixed point $p$. That is, identify a complete list of model normal forms, invariants, and local stable/unstable structures (e.g., basins of attraction, parabolic domains, Siegel-type domains, hedgehogs, resonances) that classify germs of holomorphic self-maps $(\mathbb{C}^k, 0) \to (\mathbb{C}^k, 0)$ up to local holomorphic conjugacy, especially in cases where the differential $df_p$ has eigenvalues exhibiting resonances or of modulus one.
artifact.category_tag: local holomorphic dynamics in several complex variables
artifact.status_search_result: The general classification of local dynamics of holomorphic germs near a fixed point in dimension $k \geq 2$ remains an active and largely open research program. Substantial partial results exist (Poincaré–Dulac normal forms, Hakim/Abate theory for tangent-to-identity maps, Bracci–Zaitsev, Bedford–Smillie, Ueda, and more recent work by Reppekus and others), but no complete classification is known, particularly in the presence of resonances, neutral eigenvalues, or curves of fixed points.

status_evidence.title: Fixed points and dynamics of holomorphic maps — Reppekus
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys recent developments on dynamics near fixed points of holomorphic maps in several variables, indicating the area is still developing.
status_evidence.claim: Classification near fixed points in several complex variables is an ongoing research program with many open cases.

status_evidence.title: Discrete Holomorphic Local Dynamical Systems (Abate)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of local dynamics of holomorphic maps in one and several complex variables, discussing normal forms and open problems in the non-hyperbolic case.
status_evidence.claim: A complete classification in several variables, especially in non-hyperbolic regimes, is not available.

status_evidence.title: The Dynamics of Holomorphic Maps Near Curves of Fixed Points
status_evidence.snippet: Studies particular configurations of fixed-point sets, contributing partial classification results.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial classifications are known in specific geometric configurations.
